description: Na₆Ti₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.63 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.88 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three TiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one TiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.71 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three TiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one TiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.76 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.35 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.69 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.91 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.91 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ti atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ti atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ti atom.
